name: clyde
description: Sync your Claude desktop app chats across your computers: every computer of your Clyde account adds its chats (/clyde:push) and fetches the others (/clyde:pull); existing chats are kept. Needs your own Clyde backend (Docker), Node.js 20 and the Clyde CLI. Works in Claude Code only. Docs: https://github.com/Gardosen/clyde
